theory.title: Adverbios de grado e intensificadores
theory.explanation: Usa adverbios como extremely (extremadamente), fairly (bastante), rather (algo/bastante), quite (bastante) y absolutely (absolutamente) para modificar adjetivos. Algunos intensificadores se combinan con adjetivos concretos: absolutely brilliant, completely impossible, highly recommended, deeply disappointed.
theory.tip: Algunos intensificadores tienen combinaciones habituales: highly recommended, absolutely brilliant.

patterns.label: Adverbios de grado e intensificadores · 1
examples:
The documentary was extremely informative.
→ El documental era extremadamente informativo.

patterns.label: Adverbios de grado e intensificadores · 2

→ El final fue absolutamente brillante.

patterns.label: Adverbios de grado e intensificadores · 4

content.passage: The new documentary has received extremely positive reviews. Critics describe the photography as absolutely stunning and the interviews as highly informative. Some viewers find the middle section rather slow, but most agree that the ending is deeply moving. The presenter is fairly well known, although this is probably her most impressive work so far. Overall, the programme is highly recommended for anyone interested in science.

items.prompt: Review a film and use three adverbs of degree.
items.modelAnswer: I recently watched a mystery film that was surprisingly entertaining. The story was fairly simple at first, but the final scenes were extremely clever. The actors were convincing, although the music was sometimes too loud.

items.prompt: Describe a programme that was absolutely brilliant.
items.modelAnswer: The nature programme was absolutely brilliant because it showed rare animals in their natural environment. The photography was particularly impressive, and the presenter explained difficult ideas in a very clear way.

items.prompt: Talk about a book you found rather confusing.
items.modelAnswer: I found the novel rather confusing because it had several narrators and moved between different periods. However, the characters were interesting, and the ending helped me understand how the stories were connected.

items.prompt: Recommend something that is highly informative.
items.modelAnswer: I highly recommend a documentary about the history of the internet. It explains how communication has changed and includes interviews with people who developed early technology. It is informative without being too technical.

items.prompt: Describe a performance that deeply impressed you.
items.modelAnswer: I saw a dance performance that deeply impressed me. The movements were powerful, and the music created a strong atmosphere. I hadn't expected to enjoy modern dance so much, but I would happily see it again.

items.prompt: Explain why a film was completely unbelievable.
items.modelAnswer: The film was completely unbelievable because the main character survived several dangerous accidents without any explanation. The special effects were good, but the story became less realistic with every scene.

items.prompt: Give a balanced review using fairly and extremely.
items.modelAnswer: The series was fairly entertaining and had some extremely funny moments. A few episodes were rather slow, but the main actors created believable characters. I would recommend it to people who enjoy light comedy.

items.prompt: Talk about a series that is highly popular.
items.modelAnswer: The cooking series is highly popular because the challenges are easy to understand and the contestants have different backgrounds. I like the practical tips, although some episodes are edited to create unnecessary drama.

items.prompt: Describe a story that was deeply moving.
items.modelAnswer: The short story was deeply moving because it described a family trying to stay together after moving to another country. The language was simple, but the emotions felt very real. I thought about it for several days.

items.prompt: Recommend a programme and justify your opinion.
items.modelAnswer: I recommend the programme about ocean life because it combines beautiful images with useful information. The presenter explains the problems facing marine animals and suggests practical ways viewers can reduce plastic waste.
